audience: ecommerce merchants who plan stock and reorders with Inventory Planner

useCases.title: Find products that are about to run out of stock
useCases.text: The AI lists variants with chosen metrics, such as days to sell out, forecasted lost revenue and recommended order quantity, sorted so you see which SKUs need reordering.

useCases.title: Check which vendors a SKU can be ordered from
useCases.text: The AI lists the vendors of a variant with cost price, landing cost, vendor SKU and minimum order quantity (MOQ), and opens one vendor's terms.

useCases.title: Review open purchase orders and expected dates
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders, transfers and assembly orders filtered by status, vendor or expected date, with totals ordered and received.

useCases.title: Read the line items of a purchase order
useCases.text: The AI lists a purchase order's line items with ordered and received quantities, cost price, tax and discount, and whether it was saved to connected systems.

useCases.title: Create a draft purchase order and edit it
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft purchase order from variants and quantities, and edits its reference, expected date or notes. A draft is not sent to the vendor.
